key_facts: Actor Emily Hampshire plays the AI persona E.D.I.T.H. in Marvel Television's 'VisionQuest', which premiered 14 Oct with two episodes of eight, on Disney+.
Showrunner Terry Matalas created it as the last part of a trilogy after 'WandaVision' and 'Agatha All Along'.
At New York Comic Con Hampshire said her chaotic E.D.I.T.H. comes from imagining Tony Stark's ego bottled in sunglasses and handed to a teenager.
E.D.I.T.H., first seen in 2019's 'Spider-Man: Far From Home', is now a character with a face and a 1920s aviatrix look.
Paul Bettany returns as Vision, who consults AI personas including F.R.I.D.A.Y. and J.A.R.V.I.S.
quote_evidence: "If Tony Stark bottled his ego and put it into a pair of sunglasses, gave it access to all these dangerous weapons and gave her to a teenager, who would she be after being in those glasses?"
Hampshire is best known as Stevie Budd on 'Schitt's Creek'.
why_it_matters_hint: Pop-culture take on a fictional AI character, a light read for fans.

title: Emily Hampshire Explains Why E.D.I.T.H. Is So Chaotic in 'VisionQuest,' and Blames Tony Stark
